title: Lifting the initial configuration
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a symbol type with decidable equality, let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. The initial configuration of the machine obtained by lifting $M$ along $e$ on the word obtained by applying $e$ to each symbol of $x$ equals the lift along $e$ of the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
